notes.title: Patch notes for update 1.1.4 of CRISIS Command
notes.notes:
Hello there phantoms!

In my continued attempts to make CRISIS Command the best it can be, I will be releasing a hotfix to address a number of smaller issues that have irritated players. Look forward to the following fixes:

Adjusted Cannonball damage and weakness calculations. Everyone loves a powerful weapon, but poor Thrash couldn't afford the therapy.

Adjusted text alignment and typos for the introduction of General Rend. A powerful figure should probably have a better editor for his press releases.

Updated the cursor alignment in the pause menu to make it easier to see what is being highlighted. Bounce Bolt shouldn't be able to play peak a boo with the cursor anymore.

Updated an image used in the gallery that was off center. I won't name names, but it knows what it did wrong and is very sorry.

Adjusted issues with the normal ending not displaying correctly for some when beating the game on normal. Now the conclusion will align for all players what their experiences are.

Known issue that is still being looked into:

Thrash Reaver currently will sometimes jump off screen to attack before jumping back in. His cheating shouldn't be allowed and I'm looking into ways to force him to play fair.

My thanks to many phantoms that have reached out with their issues that needed addressing. This wouldn't be possible without your help. If you are seeing any new issues, please feel free to reach out here in Patreon, over on our Discord or reach out through our Steam Forum and let me know what you find. I'm glad to work out your grievances.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update Notes for CRISIS Command version 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello there Phantoms!

In my continued quest to improve CRISIS Command to be the very best it can be, I have done the following to the game:

- Improved the difficulty selection window from the start screen. New recruits should now see an improved window that displays a description of what to expect from each difficulty option. No more needing to hope we are on the same page for what is EASY or HARD.
- Fixed the reported broken controller support for reading dialog during a cutscene. Now you can actually understand what is going on again!
- Corrected a discovered issue where the button and key prompts that tell the player what to hit to skip or show the next text weren't always popping up. My thumbs are thankful.
- Fixed a rare crash that happened when striking Hakon with a cannonball while he was prepping for his ultimate. Now he can't take his ball and go home anymore.
- Fixed a small bug where the Spider Tank could forget you were there if you just happened to sit at the edge of the screen during his introduction. 
- Removed a glich that would allow you to throw the shrapnel from the cannonball when out of energy. The pocket sand was funny, but too hard to use.
- Corrected a display issue with some text during cutscenes. Doesn't fix how weird some text is at this resolution yet, but at least the words are there to figure out!
- Fixed a crash when trying to pause during the end credits. I know some devs don't like it when players do it, but the game was never intended to get mad if you tried!
- Fixed moving platforms so it can push around almost all objects now and not just Astra. The swatbots want an easier time getting to work too.
- Corrected the gallery entries to better fit within their posts. Makes it hard to read up on your favorite characters when the words make a run for it.
- Fixed trap platforms so the bottom of them hurt all objects that touch them. Was getting a bit unfair there for a while.
- Fixed broken knockback on bosses and added some visible effects when hitting them with their weakness. Should be easier to make them pay now! 
- Fixed the doors closing behind Astra when she passes through. They don't try to take her shoes off now when she slides through. They even make noise now!
- Added an accessibility feature to Astra so you can see when your weapon is charged after the initial animation is finished. Should make it easier to verify that you still have a super shot coming.
- Addressed a complaint about the Rail shots that some bosses fire at the player so they are slightly smaller and less ominous.
- Updated the Explosions in the Airport's Tower so it matches the rubble when the ceiling gives way! Was feeling rather silly.
- Added a speed adjustment for projectiles on Easy to make them a little easier to dodge. This should make those who are rusty or inexperienced have a little bit more edge while they learn the ropes.
- Addressed an issue with Thach running out of stamina during his super move. He's supposed to be an athlete, but I think he's been skipping cardio.

Known Issues:
- The cannonball power is still a bit too powerful for what it gives out know that the weaknesses for enemies is properly tweaked. This maybe revisited later as some of the bosses have lodge complaints.
- There has been a rare issue I'm working through in the gallery where the cursor sometimes skips to the bottom. I'm working through why the cursor likes to play hopscotch with the menu still.

I appreciate all the feedback I've obtained since launch leading to the end of the year, and hope you'll continue to let me know when you discover anything unsavory. You can reach out either using the Bugs and Defects forum in the Steam Discussions, or on the Official GhostUrsa Discord channel's Tech Support section. Both are monitored regularly.

Enjoy your holidays, and I look forward to more good times with you in 2025!

Hello phantoms!

notes.title: The Difficulty Update is now live on CRISIS Command!
notes.notes:
It has been a long time coming, but with much sweat and tears I can officially say that version 1.1 is now going live! The Difficulty update has many features that have been requested by fans and I'm proud to bring them to you.

First up, we have a Gallery Mode that will be available from the stage select. As you defeat levels you'll be able to get a small bit of trivia on the enemies, allies and places found in CRISIS Command. It has been a fun challenge to set up all the entries, and I hope you enjoy getting the whole menu filled!

For those of you that have felt the game is too hard, I have added an Easy difficulty. This isn't just a rebalance of enemy damage and call it a day. I have done some work in the level and story structure to make it both easier yet fulfilling. Inspired by games like the original release of Castle of Illusion, this easy mode will have less levels to conquer, smaller areas to traverse and a redone enemy layout to make it a bit easier to figure out how to play the game. It even comes with its own What-if ending to fit the smaller size. It's a great way to get a feel for the game. When it gets more comfortable, you can then crank up a new playthrough on normal and feel the game as originally designed.

And for those of you who want some old school, Nintendo action? I've developed a Hard mode to remove those pesky breathing spaces that make the action feel broken up. Not only do enemies hit harder, but they are also faster and will come at you more frequent. Some of the enemies are even in devious locations to keep you on your toes. You'll definitely want to scour every level to save civilians to keep up with this challenge!

Finally, achievements are now added to the Steam and Epic version of the game! This has been long requested but I didn't have the bandwidth originally to get the APIs integrated properly. These are fully working now, with a full list of achievements for you to hunt down. Some hidden ones as well. Good luck getting them all!

GhostUrsa

Full patch notes are as follows:
- Created a Gallery option in the Stage Select to reference all the unlocked entries
- Created a new Gallery Menu that will show enemies, allies and entities that have been covered during the game
- Added the ability to select a difficulty when starting a new game: Easy, Normal, Hard
- Rebalanced the story to fit the new narrative for Easy mode
- Added a new ending to the game for those that complete Easy mode
- Reduced the number of enemies for the 4 levels available in Easy mode. You should have amply opportunity to get used to the game and its systems now!
- Enemy power has been reduced when playing on easy mode to take some of the edge off of the combat.
- Adjusted the layout of the lightning gauntlet in the Power Plant level. Now you can actually see the lightning before it tries to kill you!
- Made the kill shot from the Tower Topplier and a few other bosses a little smaller. It should be easier to dodge now?
- Adjusted the enemy placement in every level for hard mode. You want Nintendo hard? You got it!
- Adjusted enemy damage for Hard mode. Be ready to dodge and parry, because you'll need every edge to stay alive.
- Added custom logos for CRISIS and Dread Corps for the gallery
- Achievements have been added to the game. They can be unlocked on both Steam and Epic.
- Corrected a sound glitch with the plasma torch. It no longer tries to rev up like a chainsaw playing a bell when fired.
- Cleaned up some embarrassing typos in the dialog. I'm sure I'm not the only one who noticed.
- Updated some of the fonts used in the game to help with readability. Finding a modern font that scales to low pixel sizes is harder than I thought!
- Updated the drop rate tables for items to take into account the difficulty. You'll see 25% more on Easy and 25% less on Hard.
- Fixed an issue where sometimes when a roturret was destoryed the barrel would still exist and shoot at you. No phantom gunners here, mister!
- Corrected the Birdbomber sometimes not spawning correctly. Some of us got tired of stealth bombers showing napalm at Astra!

Known Issues that I'm still looking into:
- Sometimes platforms with grinders can hurt enemies but not friendlies. Maybe the universe wants to make things easier, but that ain't playing fair.
- Every once in a great while Astra gets stuck on a small ledge. The doctors say it's less frequent now, but the healing process has begun. Hopefully I can get the last of those issues addressed.
- Sometimes the "Press button to Skip Dialog" button is partially visible when Odin is talking. Maybe it likes stalking him? I'm still looking into it.

The last few months have finally accumulated in this update, and I'm proud of how the game has turned out. I'm not sure how much more updates I'll be able to give CRISIS Command without splitting my attention, so any improvements will be coming at a slower pace after this. If you do have issues or requests, you can use the Steam forums or reach out to my official email address with anything you discover. I'll document everything, no matter how small.

Thank you for your continued support. I hope to continue to journey with you in CRISIS Command and beyond!

notes.title: Update notes for Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello there phantoms!

In my quest to perfect my craft, I have added the following or corrected the following features in CRISIS Command! Patch notes are as follows:

- Corrected an issue where the game resolution won't change between 16:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios. Now the few people enjoying the game on the Steam Deck and hopefully avoid the dreaded black boxes. Not that they were bothering me, oh no....
- Added button prompts that show up when the player tries to skip a cutscene. Sometimes we just want to play, Odin! 
- Added an Accessibility menu with two features to toggle. For now, at least...
- Added a toggle to have the blaster auto charge in the new menu. For those of you who hadn't grown up playing old Mega Man games, you can save your thumbs some pain now! It's too late for me though.
- Added an adjustment option for the jump edge guard. This will make it so players don't have to be quite so accurate with their jumping when running towards the edge. You can control this slightly so it can be as forgiving or old school as you want!
- Fixed a bug where Astra could charge her blaster, get hit and continue to fire a full shot afterwards. Sorry, phantoms but no more face tanking for that perfect full charged shot.

Known issues I'm still looking into:

- Every once in a blue moon, Astra gets her face stuck in invisible barriers or tiny ledges. Her family is getting a bit sad when looking at the bills coming in for the dental work.

Please continue to let me know when you discover defects, pain points and weird behaviors while playing CRISIS Command. I'm happy to continue to improve the product.

Enjoy until next time!

notes.title: Update notes for Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello phantoms!

In my ever-quest to improve CRISIS Command to the best it can be, I have updated the following features to squash some annoying bugs or correct issues:

- adjusted the second checkpoint of the airport's location. Now you won't see my background changes, or my unsightly bathtub ring...
- Adjusted the text display for the Weapon Select prompts at the top of the pause menu. The should finally stay in their cage!
- Astra's wall jumping transitions are now smoother. Let that girl fly!
- Added a slight grip to when wall sliding is activated with Astra before gravity kicks in. This should make getting those wall jumps more accurate now.
- Increased the speed of the fire bolt and fire thrower weapons. Anthracite should be a more threatening boss now. Don't say I didn't warn you.
- Updated the frequency of how much dust is kicked into the air when wall grinding and dashing. That much dust can't be good for the lungs. 
- Updated the fall protection tooltip in the pause menu. It should better describe how the protection works on pits and spikes for less confusion.
- Increased the aggression range of the Spidertank mini-boss slightly. No more hiding in that one pixel out in the open and playing peek-a-boo anymore.
- Added a tooltip button prompt that pops up when hovering over the Parry and Plasma Torch icons in the pause menu. It should dynamically show you what button/key you have configured for that action now.
- Reduced the lifespan of debris when flying through the air. Debris should try to reach orbit when launched.
- Adjusted the fire missile speed. This should make Thrash a little more dangerous.
- Speaking of Thrash, corrected the bug where sometimes he'd just constantly barrel-roll instead of land. A hilarious issue, but sadly I am running out of Pepto to give the poor guy
- Added a Civilian rescue count to the pause menu. Now you will have an idea on how many people are thankful for your efforts!
- Corrected Hakon's skipping when he is running around. A battlefield is not the time for lolly-gagging, Hakon!
- Corrected rotating turret's aim logic so it will fire at all angles when facing right. Sorry phantoms, but that blindspot has now been filled.

Known issues I'm still looking into:

- Every once in a blue moon, Astra gets her face stuck in invisible barriers or tiny ledges. Her dentist wishes I'd hurry, as the insurance rate is going up because of it.

Please continue to let me know when you discover defects, pain points and weird behaviors while playing CRISIS Command. I'm happy to continue to improve the product.

Enjoy until next time!

notes.title: Update information for version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello there phantoms! In my ever continuing quest to improve the quality of my software, I have deployed an update that will help ease your burdens a little. The following will be available shortly for you to download:

- Fixed an issue where the new sound cleanup was looking for the wrong sound in a few instances. Save the ghost hunting for the professionals
- Corrected the keybind parser so it will show the correct keybinds for keyboards in the options. This should make it much easier for you to know what is actually your preferred keys, assuming gremlins don't get into the wires.
- Updated the button prompt billboards in the tutorial to have them all animate properly. That should help players figure out how to get through the Tower Topplier's ambush easier!
- Updated on of the tutorial billboards to show both D-pad and Analog prompts for those players that love options!
- Adjusted the cursor offset to make it slightly easier to see where it is next to some of the buttons. At least now I have to blame my poor vision on me instead of the font. 
- Added a slight grace period after leaving the ground to allow the player to still jump. It should make it easier to get those pixel perfect jumps in later levels now. I'm still up for feedback on this one.
- Made the sawball minions messier when they dig through the Earth to get you. The extra particles should make it a little easier to not stub your toes on them.
- Added a button prompt to the Weapon Acquired screen to know when you can leave. Otherwise it gets awkward...
- Updated the pause menu's button prompts to be a little easier to read, and added two new ones when the Plasma Torch and Parry features are available. Should make it easier to know what buttons to press wtihout going to the Options menu. Nobody has time for that!

Known issues I'm still looking into:
- Wall sliding to a wall jump has been reported as slippery for some players. The new grace period should help with that, but more maybe needed. I appreciate any feedback on this as I continue working on it.
- Some players have reported that dashing sometimes fails to register. Any information as to button combinations hit when this happens or what is going on in the level is greatly appreciated!
- Every once in a blue moon, Astra gets her face stuck in invisible barriers or tiny ledges. Her dentist wishes I'd hurry, but it's taking time to identify the specifics.

Please continue to let me know when you discover defects, pain points and weird behaviors while playing CRISIS Command. I'm happy to continue to improve the product.

Enjoy until next time!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2.1
notes.notes:
Hello phantoms! A hotfix is deployed that will address the following issue:

Known issues:

- Wall sliding to wall jumping has been reported to feel slippery for some players. I'll keep looking at why this is not the same for everyone
- Some players have reported that dashing in general sometimes fails to register. I'm still looking into that.
- Every once in a blue moon, Astra gets her face stuck in invisible barriers or tiny ledges. I'm trying to figure out why. It can't be good for her teeth.

Please continue to let me know when you discover defects, pain points and weird behaviors while playing CRISIS Command. I'm happy to continue to improve the product.

notes.title: Update to Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
In my continued attempt to keep my game up to the expectations of all you phantoms, I have updated the following in CRISIS Command:

- Moved around some of the Super Urchins and Sawballs in the seaport to make them a little fairer. It took a bit but they finally calmed down after the Tiger Eel got them riled up.
- Rearranged some of the layout of the end of the spike tunnel in the seaport to make it fairer. Excavation took a bit but there should be a bit more room in there now to maneuver.
- Updated Hakon's grammar during his introduction so he doesn't sound unintelligent. Leave the tongue-tied reactions to me!
- Slowed the credits crawl a little to make them easier to read. Hopefully more than the speed readers can know who helped me out!
- Adjusted the boundary interactions in the Waste Management stage so you have to fight your battles. Hopefully no more teasing that boss!
- Added knockback to the wind tunnel power. Its base power was dropped a little to compensate. At least now you can scatter opponents to the 4 winds!
- Added better sound error handling to when levels restart to prevent the buffer from hating the player. Rockets and explosions should hopefully stop roaring at you after you die.
- Added some invincibility to the player after they defeat the stage boss. Too many bosses are being poor sports and going for that double ko. Time to end those shenanigans! 
- Cleaned up some unnecessary sound effects from some sfx. Should help make sure we don't get duplicate sounds.

Known issues:
- Wall sliding to wall jumping has been reported to feel slippery for some players. I'll keep looking at why this is not the same for everyone
- Some players have reported that dashing in general sometimes fails to register. I'm still looking into that.
- Every once in a blue moon, Astra gets her face stuck in invisible barriers or tiny ledges. I'm trying to figure out why. It can't be good for her teeth.

Please continue to let me know when you discover defects, pain points and weird behaviors while playing CRISIS Command. I'm happy to continue to improve the product.

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
To ensure that CRISIS Command is able to be the best shape it can for all you phantoms out there, the following changes have been performed to the game:

- Fixed a bug discovered that will randomly crash the game when the Tower Topplier boss on the Tutorial stage dies when the player does. No more double KO for you Mister!
- Fixed a spike jump in the warehouse of the airport stage. Your toes will thank you later.
- Corrected Thach Reaver's super attack to fire the rockets he promised me
- Adjusted the Tiger Eel so he doesn't just stand there derping out as often
- Slightly adjusted the i-frames for the Tiger Eel so he doesn't feel so sad all the time
- Adjusted how dash jumps are calculated so performing it in sequential jumps is easier. Continue parkouring, you mad lads!
- Updated the Hawkopter and Minionwalker mini-bosses so they stop shooting over Astra's head and embarrassing me
- Hakon's jump is a lower smaller than before. He may not have skipped leg day but that was still ridiculous!
- Updated the plasma torch so the hit sfx is along the blade instead of that the hilt
- fixed some situations where Hakon can moonwalk after jumping. He's not supposed to be a smooth operator.
- death vacuums now have one weakness to exploit. Go find it!
- Corrected a rare crash that would happen when Hakon tried to stab the wall with a plasma torch
- Updated the temporary boundaries to stop allowing the player to escape after pausing the game during a boss fight. I didn't hear no bell, and you didn't either!
- Had an editor go over all the dialog so it makes sense. 

Known issue I'm still working on:
- Sometimes the warning icon doesn't have its sound play
- rarely Astra will get her face stuck in an invisible boundary or tiny wall

If you find any issues with the game, please record them in the Bugs & Technical Issues sub-forum on Steam. I take all feedback and issues seriously and will triage them as I get them.
